name: en_settings_tts
title: English UI — Settings pane, TTS configurator, Quick Settings over Phrase Flip
persona: An onboarded English+Spanish learner opening Settings from Home. Screenshots the single Settings pane (Stacks, languages, levels, Plus / Advanced+dev unlock), opens the standalone Text-to-speech configurator, then opens Quick Settings over Phrase Flip.

beats.narrate: Seed an onboarded English + Spanish stack.
Settings pane — Stacks, languages, levels, rate, Plus, Advanced.
Confirm the standalone TTS configurator entry button is present.
Open the Text-to-speech configurator (standalone, over Settings).
TTS configurator — per-language voice picker + Choose voices disclosure.
beats.wait_text: Tap a voice to hear it

beats.narrate: Back out of the configurator (the standalone Back arrow).
Back on Home — open Phrase Flip to reach the in-pack Quick settings.
Open Quick settings (the in-pack gear, leading corner).
Quick settings sheet — speed, languages, levels, phrase packs, Full settings.
Confirm the Full settings escape hatch is present.
